description: This PHP class file defines a page object for testing purposes within the SuiteCRM system. It provides methods to determine the current screen breakpoint based on browser width, using a tester object to execute JavaScript. The class interacts with the SuiteCRM design breakpoints and implements functions to fetch browser dimensions.

classes.name: Page\Design
classes.description: A page object class used in testing SuiteCRM design breakpoints, providing methods to get browser dimensions and determine breakpoints.

methods.name: getBreakpointString
methods.description: Returns a string representing the current design breakpoint based on the browser width.

methods.name: getBrowserWidth
methods.description: Executes JavaScript to get the width of the browser window.

methods.name: getBrowserHeight
methods.description: Executes JavaScript to get the height of the browser window.
